4x Game AI 2.0 - an ESRGAN model by Tal (https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-GameAI-2-0), for game textures, under
the WTFPL below. uaRO Graphics ships it as 4x-gameai-2.0.bin: the same network, its weights as 16-bit halves.
